phase3_findings.description: A comment credited the uppercase AUTHORIZATION: BASIC form to actions/checkout; this repo in fact persists a lowercase scheme keyword.
Two assertion names said the uppercase scheme keyword is 'still' redacted, implying behaviour that predated this diff.
Only the escape units \/ and \\ are admitted, so another escape shape terminates the match.
The acceptance criterion names the #1064 D4 block and the assertions land above the D4/AC8 heading.

fix_decisions.claim_text: only two escape units are admitted
fix_decisions.evidence: admitting a backslash before any character reintroduces the original defect (swallowing the JSON escape before a closing quote); no credential alphabet contains a raw backslash, and two agents independently judged this not a new fail-open

parking_evidence.basis: the only widening that would admit other escapes is exactly the defect this change fixes
parking_evidence.failing_input: a token followed by a lone backslash before a closing quote

fix_decisions.claim_text: the assertions do not sit under the D4/AC8 heading the criterion names
fix_decisions.evidence: #1064 D4 is the coverage map's label for scripts/scrub-credentials.sh, and the assertions sit with the block's other scrub-credentials: assertions; the engine's own checklist confirmed the region

parking_evidence.basis: the criterion names a coverage-map label, not a literal heading in the file
parking_evidence.failing_input: the criterion's '#1064 D4 block' wording read as a literal heading

fix_delta.reason: the Step 3.5 gate ran once on iteration 1 and was not re-dispatched on later iterations; the Step 2.6 shadow is the backstop

verification_evidence.focused_selection: scripts/scrub-credentials.sh and lib/test/run.sh are both run.sh-resident (coverage-map owner: unmodularized), so the covering instrument is lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith; lib/test/modules/review-trigger-helpers.sh is the covering module for the dependent #409 scrub fixture. Both ran green after the fix: monolith 9906 passed / 0 failed / 1 skipped (the dirty-tree #434 self-scan), review-trigger-helpers 844 passed / 0 failed. single_flight_consulted: no.
